**Requirement ids:** **SIG-INGEST-027/028** (every row carries `compact_status`/`custody_posture`/`ingestion_permitted=false`; the loader gate refuses all fifteen new sources until the operator's flip) · **P8-5** (the Part VIII field screens — Shelbyville's per-device "Hits" read-aggregates, Temecula's stream URL, Alabaster's serials, South Fulton's editor-tracking columns never enter an allowlist and never emit) · **SIG-ONTO-052a** (every declared `technology` slug is a generated-registry member — all sixteen targets type `alpr-fixed` by declaration, never a `traffic_camera` fallback or name inference) · **SIG-RECON-041/042**-adjacent (a removal is a recorded `valid_to`/`status` temporal claim — the canceled-vs-installed distinction — never an erased record) · **§19.1** (geometry SRID 4326; the publisher's `approximate` precision caveat declared and carried on the record).
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/278_P36.5__agency-alpr-flock-layers.md` (manifest row 278) · **Base:** `r11/P36.4-official-camera-layers` (`6b07f7f3`) · **Branch:** `r11/P36.5-agency-alpr-flock-layers` · **OM-20 posture:** none — committed registry/target/cadence rows, emit-path declarations and fixtures only; no deploy, no fetch, no `ingestion_permitted` flip, no gate ticked. Live legs: none.

## Why

Wave-B batch `r11-layers-02` needs fifteen agency-origin ALPR/Flock layers registered — the FDOT District-3 inventory (407) plus its **removal-status ledger** (523) which must ingest **in the same run** so a removal fact is never asserted against a stale inventory (I8 §5.2), plus fourteen municipal Flock/LPR layers — all landing `ingestion_permitted=false` behind the RB-01 `a` rights batch. The 2026 FDOT removal wave is why the batch stays monthly even for nominally static layers: currency is the value, and a `+0` re-run costs nothing.

## What ships

- **`dot_511.py` (+219):** the declared **status disposition** — `status_disposition="removal"` marks a removal-ledger target; it requires the target's declared `removal_status_values` vocabulary, validated fail-closed at `validate`/expansion/emit (`StatusDispositionNotDeclared`, a registry defect, never a per-record rejection). A removal row bounds the device: a published date column (new `removal_date_fields` alias) emits `valid_to` with `valid_to_kind="exact"`; a removal flag with no date emits `valid_to_kind="unknown"` — **never a fabricated date, never a deletion**, and the bound stamps every claim the row emits so a device is never half-removed. Non-removal statuses mint no bound and ride `camera_status` verbatim (S5 guard). The declared **`coordinate_precision`** (`"approximate"` — Milford's published caveat) stamps the entity + coordinate claims so an approximate point can never be re-asserted as exact downstream (P4).
- **`cli.py`:** `sig-connectors validate` gains the status/coordinate registry rule.
- **Vocab 2026.10.12.2:** `removal_date_fields`; aliases `LAT`/`LONG`/`NAME`, `Location_Name`, `StateRoad`, `Town`, `Permit_Jurisdiction`, `City`, `DirectionFacing`. Additive only.
- **Sixteen targets pinned:** the FDOT pair on the consolidated `camreg_fdot_flock` source (the two ACQ-01 generated rows `camreg_fl_d3_flock_camera`/`camreg_fl_flock_removal_status` merge — 596 → 595 registered) + fourteen municipal layers; counts (live-read where evidenced; ≈50 plan estimates marked — outgrowth fails loud on `exceededTransferLimit`), `object_id_field`, `out_fields` allowlists (never `outFields=*`), `iso.3166_2` jurisdiction + place/county GEOIDs (I8 R4), `rights_note` (RB-01 `a`). Row rules carried as declarations: removal → `valid_to`, Prince William `status="Proposed"` verbatim, Milford `coordinate_precision="approximate"`, Shelbyville Hits columns excluded, Leon Vigilant LPR layer → `alpr-fixed` (RTCC/CCTV layers type separately when registered; the `camreg_leon_fl` same-org check resolved DIFFERENT ORG — `ptvDyBs1KkcwzQNJ` ≠ `cotinter.leoncountyfl.gov`).
- **Fifteen gated sources wired:** `sources.toml`, `runner.py` (+15 → `dot_511`), `live_targets.toml`, `live_dispositions.toml` (16 placeholder `promote` rows resolved), `ops/cadence.toml` `r11-layers-02` reconciled to 15 members.
- **Fixtures + tests:** 16 committed ArcGIS fixtures; `test_dot_511_acq09.py` (32 tests) drives the real `pipeline.run` — same-run FDOT pair, exact/unknown/absent bounds, proposed status, approximate precision, exclusions, fail-closed declarations, deterministic replay/shadow; `test_review_status.py` pins updated for the consolidation.
